pr.title: fix(core): Align /credentials/for-workflow response with its frontend type
pr.body: ## Summary `GET /credentials/for-workflow` was returning a slim shape (`id`, `name`, `type`, `scopes`, `isManaged`, `isGlobal`, `isResolvable`, `connectedByMe?`) while the frontend typed it as `ICredentialsResponse[]`. Callers reading `updatedAt`, `homeProject`, `sharedWithProjects`, or `currentUserHasAccess` got `undefined` at runtime — the type was lying. This widens the backend response to match what the frontend type promises: - `createdAt`, `updatedAt` — from the entity, free - `homeProject`, `sharedWithProjects` — via existing `ownershipService.addOwnedByAndSharedWith`; needs one extra `getAllRelationsForCredentials` query, same one `GET /credentials` already runs - `currentUserHasAccess: true` — by construction, since the response is the intersection of "user can access" ∩ "workflow/project can access" The frontend `ICredentialsResponse[]` typing stays as-is — no FE code changes were needed because the returned shape is now structurally compatible. As now be returns extended type (including `homeProject`), the AgentAddTriggerModal was updated too: before: after: ### Test plan - `pnpm test src/credentials/__tests__/credentials.service.test.ts` — strengthened unit tests assert the full payload shape (including `homeProject` / `sharedWithProjects` / `currentUserHasAccess`), the null-`homeProject` case for global credentials, and that the shared-relations query is skipped when the intersection is empty - `pnpm test src/modules/agents/__tests__/agents.controller.test.ts` and `agents-credential-provider.test.ts` — mock fixtures updated to the new shape; all pass ## Related Linear tickets, Github issues, and Community forum posts https://linear.app/n8n/issue/IAM-679 ## Review / Merge checklist - [x] I have seen this code, I have run this code, and I take responsibility for this code. - [x] PR title and summary are descriptive. - [x] Docs updated or follow-up ticket created (no user-facing docs affected). - [x] Tests included. - [ ] PR Labeled with \`Backport to Beta\`, \`Backport to Stable\`, or \`Backport to v1\` (if the PR is an urgent fix that needs to be backported) 🤖 PR Summary generated by AI

review_comments.body:
suggestion (non-blocking): I would suggest to create a service specific type on the top of the service file, defining what this method returns. Most of the other methods just return the repo entity but seems like the frontend need a bit more in terms of data. 

In general I prefer backend having common uniform types and define the interface that the frontend consumers (or any other consumer really) but let's stick to a simple solution for now to mitigate frontend having wrong impression of the return type

**No issues found** across 4 files
Architecture diagram ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant FE as Frontend Client participant API as GET /credentials/for-workflow participant CS as CredentialsService participant CFR as CredentialsFinderService participant CR as CredentialsRepository participant SCR as SharedCredentialsRepository participant OS as OwnershipService participant RS as RoleService participant CPS as ConnectionStatusProxy FE->>API: Request credentials for workflow API->>CS: getCredentialsAUserCanUseInAWorkflow(user, { workflowId }) CS->>CFR: findCredentialsForUser(user) CFR-->>CS: Credentials user can access CS->>CR: findAllCredentialsForWorkflow(workflowId) CR-->>CS: Credentials workflow can access CS->>CS: Compute intersection (user ∩ workflow) alt Intersection is empty CS-->>API: Return empty array [] else Intersection has items CS->>SCR: getAllRelationsForCredentials(credentialIds) SCR-->>CS: Shared relations with project info CS->>CS: Attach shared relations to each credential loop For each credential in intersection CS->>OS: addOwnedByAndSharedWith(credential) OS-->>CS: Credential with homeProject & sharedWithProjects CS->>RS: addScopes(credential, user, projectRelations) RS-->>CS: Credential with scopes end CS->>CS: Build response payload Note over CS: Includes: createdAt, updatedAt, homeProject,
sharedWithProjects, currentUserHasAccess: true CS->>CPS: findConnectedCredentialIds(user) CPS-->>CS: Set of connected credential IDs CS->>CS: populateConnectedByMe(result, user) CS-->>API: ICredentialsResponse[] with full shape end API-->>FE: 200 JSON response ```
